test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the correct statement.

options.text: Investment multiplier is positively related to MPC.
Slope of the consumption function is indicated by APC, and not MPC.
Investment multiplier is zero when MPS is zero.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Investment multiplier is positively related to MPC. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The stimulating **impacts **of **governmental **or **private investments **are referred to as the **investment multiplier.**
 
• It is based on **John Maynard Keynes'** economic **theories**.
 
• The **marginal propensity to save (MPS) **and the** marginal propensity to consume (MPC) **determine the size of the investment multiplier (MPS).
 
• An investment's potential to stimulate the economy more strongly is indicated by a **higher investment multiplier. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The **percentage **of **additional income **that is spent on consumption is known as** the marginal propensity to consume.**
 
• **Depending** on **income**, MPC **fluctuates**.
 
• MPC **tends **to be **lower **at **higher income levels.**
 
• The **Keynesian multiplier**, which describes the impact of the additional investment or government spending as an economic stimulus, is mostly determined by MPC.
